about: Package 11's accepted differences between the concept's page and the rebuild's in its states (slice-states/110-notes-logs.mjs, scope notes: the notes drawer, its scrim, the engine log, the VRAM meter), each with its reason and its exact count (vb.mjs compare --accept). A difference these do not cover fails the comparison.

accepted.why: Deviation P11-1: four of the notes' sentences say what the rebuild does where it differs on purpose (the tier keys wait under a dialog, F-08; Delete resets a knob, deviation 13; Ctrl+Z in the engine panel undoes, deviation 30; 8 takes on ACE-Step, deviation 27), in every state (the notes are drawn while closed, as the concept's).
The same four sentences' lengths: a point one line taller, and its list with it, in the states where the notes are open.
Deviation 6: the notes' × and the log's Close say their type (button).

Package 8's tooltips: a press gives the hovered control's title back and the tip takes it again only when it shows (package 8's notes, after its merge); the concept's tip keeps the meter's title held after the click that opened the log.
Deviation P11-2: the models line is tagged with the engine's short id, [yue2], where the concept writes [yue].
The drawer's shot differs in the four changed sentences (P11-1) and the lines below them.
